s.note: Smoky paprika-dusted devilled eggs. Alice says Chloe's breath smells like egg.
s.how: Simmer the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool them in iced water and peel. Halve the eggs and mash the yolks with the mayo, mustard and lemon juice. Pipe or spoon the filling back into the whites. Dust with paprika and scatter with chives.

s.note: Popcorn chicken and sriracha mayo in paper cups.
s.how: Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with a pinch of salt. Mix the flours, garlic powder and paprika and toss the chicken through until coated. Fry in batches in oil at 180C until golden and cooked through. Stir the sriracha into the mayo and serve the chicken in paper cups with the dip.

m.note: Big spiced beef burritos, best caught, not thrown from the bus.
m.how: Cook the rice. Brown the mince and onion with the spices, then stir in the beans and a splash of water and simmer. Warm the tortillas and fill each with rice, beef, cheese, sour cream and salsa. Roll up tightly, tucking in the ends, and toast seam side down in a hot pan.

m.n: Ladies of the '80s pulled pork sliders
m.note: Smoky pulled pork in soft rolls.
m.how: Rub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Put it in a lidded pot with the apple juice and half the sauce and bake at 150C until it pulls apart. Shred the pork and toss with the rest of the sauce. Mix the cabbage with the mayo. Fill the rolls with pork, slaw and pickles.

w.note: Baked New York cheesecake with warm berry sauce.
w.how: Crush the biscuits, mix with the butter and press into a lined 22cm springform tin. Beat the cream cheese and 170g sugar until smooth, then beat in the eggs, sour cream, vanilla and zest. Pour over the base and bake at 150C until just wobbly in the middle, then cool in the oven with the door ajar. Simmer the berries with the rest of the sugar until saucy and serve warm over slices.

d.note: Vodka and cranberry punch with lime, served over ice.
d.how: Stir the vodka, cranberry and lime juice in a jug. Pour over ice in red cups and top with soda.
